batch.title: SEC-104 site-map zone recovery
batch.goal: Finish the checkpointed site-map zone bridge after its migration and authorization prerequisites are verified.
exitCriteria: Site-map zone collection and item commands enforce acting organization, capability, ownership, idempotency, and audit behavior.
Fresh migration, reconciliation, direct RLS bypass, retry, and recovery evidence passes.

specTasks.title: Migrate existing Admin endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory reaches 100% classification; high-risk finance/ticketing/logistics and all tour mutations migrate first; CI rejects unclassified new endpoints.

specTasks.title: Add organization inheritance to maps
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized tour/event users discover maps by capability; external collaborator/token behavior remains scoped and tested.

specTasks.title: Add map versions and lifecycle
acceptanceCriteria: Draft/review/approved/published/superseded/archived with immutable published versions, thumbnails/checksum, source file, owner, and audit.

specTasks.title: Link operational objects
acceptanceCriteria: Notes/tasks/markers can link locations to run-of-show, equipment, entrances, credentials, vendors, incidents, and checklist items.

specTasks.title: Harden file/token access
acceptanceCriteria: Original/derived assets require org/grant/token checks, signed short-lived URLs, scan/type/size validation, expiry/revocation, and access logs.

specTasks.title: Add review/approval workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Internal/external collaborator comments, requested changes, resolved threads, approver, and approved version are visible.

specTasks.title: Publish map projections
acceptanceCriteria: Day sheet/tour book references exact approved map version; worker/vendor/public variants hide restricted layers and remain accessible offline as permitted.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

launchGates.title: Migration validation passes
launchGates.acceptance: Every governed migration has safe SQL and matching evidence manifest.

launchGates.title: Two-organization RLS matrix passes
launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.
